entities.name: Zambezia Company
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Zambezia Company, a political institution in Mozambique during Late Colonial Mozambique (1891–1942). Grew from Niassa Company and Mozambique Company. Led to the emergence of Chibalo Forced Labour System and Estado Novo in Mozambique.
